title: P3 for City-Owned Property - Historic Diesel Plant
short_description: P3 redevelopment and adaptive reuse of the Historic Diesel Plant in Key West.
project_scope: Conceptual proposals are requested from qualified private entities for a potential public-private partnership involving redevelopment, rehabilitation, financing, operation, maintenance, and adaptive reuse of the Historic Diesel Plant, a city-owned property in Key West. No technical dimensions, gross floor area, span data, or detailed building parameters are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services and civil engineering as part of a P3 concept proposal for redevelopment, rehabilitation, financing, operation, maintenance, and adaptive reuse.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing historic building redevelopment/adaptive reuse project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structural project.
- Procurement is for a P3 developer/design-build concept rather than clearly defined structural engineering services.
- Civil engineering is mentioned, but no specific structural scope, complexity, or innovative load-bearing system is described.
- Could offer indirect strategic relevance if teamed with a developer, but overall fit for sbp is limited.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available information only indicates a P3 redevelopment, rehabilitation, financing, operation, maintenance, and adaptive reuse of the Historic Diesel Plant in Key West; no area, program, or technical data are provided to support a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because the procurement is a conceptual P3 proposal without defined engineering scope, service phases, or construction cost, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified private entities are requested; disciplines requested include design-build/developer and civil engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
